property.description: Log configuration of the Amoro Management Service (log4j2.xml); logs are written to the Amoro log dir.

<Configuration monitorInterval="10"> <properties> <property name="LOG_HOME">${sys:log.home}</property> <property name="CONSOLE_LEVEL">${env:CONSOLE_LOG_LEVEL:-off}</property> </properties>
<Appenders> <Console name="consoleAppender" target="SYSTEM_OUT"> <!--Set log format and color--> <PatternLayout pattern="%d %p [%t] [%logger{39}] [%X{RequestId}] - %m%n"/> </Console> <!--*********************File Log***********************--> <!--Logs with a grade of debug--> <RollingFile name="debugFileAppender" fileName="${LOG_HOME}/ams-debug.log" filePattern="${LOG_HOME}/history/ams-debug-%i.log.gz"> <!--Set log format--> <PatternLayout> <pattern>%d %p [%t] [%logger{39}] [%X{RequestId}] - %m%n</pattern> </PatternLayout> <Policies> <!--Set log file slice parameters--> <!--<OnStartupTriggeringPolicy/>--> <!--Set the log base file size to trigger rolling log file updates if the size is exceeded--> <SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy size="2048MB"/> </Policies> <DefaultRolloverStrategy max="25"/> </RollingFile>
<!--Logs with a grade of info--> <RollingFile name="infoFileAppender" fileName="${LOG_HOME}/ams-info.log" filePattern="${LOG_HOME}/history/ams-info-%d{yyyy-MM-dd}-%i.log.gz"> <!--Set log format--> <PatternLayout> <pattern>%d %p [%t] [%logger{39}] [%X{RequestId}] - %m%n</pattern> </PatternLayout> <Policies> <!--Set the time for rolling updates of log files, depending on the file naming filePattern setting--> <TimeBasedTriggeringPolicy interval="1" modulate="true"/> <!--Set the log base file size to trigger rolling log file updates if the size is exceeded--> <SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy size="2048MB"/> </Policies> <DefaultRolloverStrategy fileIndex="nomax"> <Delete basePath="${LOG_HOME}/history" maxDepth="1"> <IfFileName glob="*.log.gz"/> <IfAny> <IfLastModified age="7d"/> <IfAccumulatedFileSize exceeds="20GB" /> </IfAny> </Delete> </DefaultRolloverStrategy> </RollingFile>
<!--Logs with a grade of error--> <RollingFile name="errorFileAppender" fileName="${LOG_HOME}/ams-error.log" filePattern="${LOG_HOME}/history/ams-error-%i.log.gz"> <!--Set log format--> <PatternLayout> <pattern>%d %p [%t] [%logger{39}] [%X{RequestId}] - %m%n</pattern> </PatternLayout> <Policies> <!--Set log file slice parameters--> <!--<OnStartupTriggeringPolicy/>--> <!--Set the log base file size to trigger rolling log file updates if the size is exceeded--> <SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy size="64MB"/> </Policies> <DefaultRolloverStrategy max="7"/> </RollingFile>
<!--Logs for iceberg metrics report --> <RollingFile name="amoroMetricReporter" fileName="${LOG_HOME}/amoro-metrics.log" filePattern="${LOG_HOME}/metrics/iceberg-metrics-%i.log.gz"> <PatternLayout> <pattern>%d %p [%t] [%logger{39}] [%X{RequestId}] - %m%n</pattern> </PatternLayout> <Policies> <SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy size="64MB"/> </Policies> <DefaultRolloverStrategy max="7"/> </RollingFile> </Appenders>
<Loggers> <logger name="amoro.metric" level="info" additivity="false"> <!-- iceberg rest metric reporter logs --> <AppenderRef ref="amoroMetricReporter"/> </logger>
<logger name="org.apache.iceberg.metrics.LoggingMetricsReporter" level="info" additivity="false"> <!-- iceberg rest metric reporter logs --> <AppenderRef ref="amoroMetricReporter"/> </logger>
<logger name="org.apache.spark" level="warn" additivity="false"> <AppenderRef ref="infoFileAppender"/> <AppenderRef ref="consoleAppender" level="${CONSOLE_LEVEL}"/> </logger>
<logger name="org.apache.iceberg.BaseMetastoreCatalog" level="debug"/>
<logger name="org.apache.iceberg.BaseMetastoreTableOperations" level="debug"/>
<logger name="org.apache.iceberg.SnapshotScan" level="debug"/>
<Root level="debug"> <!--By default, debug logs are not printed--> <!--<AppenderRef ref="debugFileAppender" level="debug"/>--> <AppenderRef ref="infoFileAppender" level="info"/> <AppenderRef ref="errorFileAppender" level="error"/> <!-- SET CONSOLE_LOG_LEVEL=info to print console logger in docker --> <AppenderRef ref="consoleAppender" level="${CONSOLE_LEVEL}" /> </Root>
</Loggers>
</Configuration>
